name: je-pillar-two
description: Jersey Pillar Two reference for the October 2026 statutory snapshot, distinguishing Multinational Corporate Income Tax from Income Inclusion Rule tax. Covers entity/reporting classification, annual de minimis elections, selected income, loss and credit mechanics, registration, returns, payment, amendments, penalties and appeals. Use for Jersey MCIT, IIR, GloBE reporting or multinational constituent entities. Preserves 2025/2026 law differences, dated OECD recognition and conditional administrative concessions. Hypothetical calculations require established statutory inputs. Complete GloBE computation, safe harbours, delegated instruments and operational filing remain specialist gaps. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and is incomplete as an operational corporate companion.
